Specification: This specification models a minimal one-variable state machine used to exercise a TLC constant-override assertion-error scenario. The module declares an operator-valued constant x0 of arity 2, initializes the single variable x to TRUE, and in the next-state action assigns x' to the result of calling x0 on the arguments "no error" and TRUE. The file also contains an embedded TLC configuration that sets INIT and NEXT and overrides x0 with AssertError, so the notable design point is testing tool behavior under a constant override rather than specifying a substantive distributed algorithm. No temporal correctness theorem or liveness property is asserted in the module body.
